name: Tidewild
summary: Tidewild is a mobile action RPG set on a wild island whose six element stones (fire, ice, lightning, wind, light and dark) have been stolen. The player starts as a castaway and grows stronger by clearing monster camps, which raises the hero's damage, health and speed. Each chapter ends in a boss fight, including the Lizard Warrior, the Ice Golem and the three Bone Dragon brothers, and wins back one of the elements. Element gems can be forged into swords, bows and wands, giving attacks an element, a passive effect and a special ability. The game has more than 200 items to collect in sets, a 40-stage Colosseum of monster waves, and PvP. It can be played in portrait with one thumb, with an optional auto mode.
